bootstrap: Circular moving blocks of global genesis years, same selected years for all basins; resample entire SIDs within each selected year; retain all recurrent observations of each SID together
models: ridge logistic basin + season + year + initial state
same model plus RH, shear, SST
basin_regularization_reason: Unpenalized basin pilot failed at a separated resample; weak Normal(0,2.5^2) contrast penalty added before completing any inference; no resamples dropped
standardization_target: pooled observed common-support SID covariate distribution, bootstrap reweighted
support: Sensitivity only: all complete cases in the four adequately sampled basins; no marginal-range trimming, hence more extrapolation than primary common-support analysis
reference: first observed downcross after first-LMI anchored near-peak window; all exposures at that time, outcomes strictly later
outcome: at least one qualifying subsequent return within the recorded lifecycle, not a fixed-48h outcome
followup: observed-lifecycle probability does not identify the probability beyond record termination; risk intervals stop at first missing interval in each departure episode; no extrapolation
